versions.changelog:
Initial release of the Drawing skill for generating children's drawings and coloring pages.

- Modular prompt protocol for clean, print-ready outputs across multiple image models
- Style packs, coloring-page rules, and kid-safe constraints by age group
- Memory system for user preferences, winning prompts, and character/scene continuity
- Model-portable adapters for OpenClaw and user-configured image models
- Fast prompt starters and detailed protocols for different use cases (color, coloring page, educational)
- Security note: only prompt text and reference images are sent out
